name: Nekogahoratoori Gakuen - Mahou Gakubu Eishou Gakka
original_name: 猫洞通学園　魔法学部詠唱学科
source:
Main character enters a law department in a university, but it appears to be magic department in reality. He does not understand magic at all, so needs help from another person. The girls around him are all strange and with unique personality traits. Will he find common language with them and pass the test in time?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公进入了大学的法学部，但实际上那里似乎是魔法学部。他对魔法一窍不通，所以需要别人的帮助。他身边的女孩们都很奇怪，性格独特。他能和她们找到共同语言并按时通过考试吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
